item.title: A 19-year record of atmospheric sulphur dioxide (SO2) derived from IASI measurements
item.description:
A 19-year record of atmospheric sulphur dioxide (SO2) derived from IASI measurements
Lieven Clarisse, Bruno Franco, Lorenzo Fabris, Nicolas Theys, Juliette Hadji-Lazaro, Daniel Hurtmans, Cathy Clerbaux, and Pierre Coheur
Earth Syst. Sci. Data, 18, 6667–6706, https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-18-6667-2026, 2026
We present a 19-year (2007–2026) global record of atmospheric sulphur dioxide (SO2) abundances and plume altitudes measured twice a day from space by the Infrared Atmospheric Sounding Interferometers (IASI). The first part of the paper covers the retrieval methodology and detailed comparisons with other satellite measurements. The second part presents an overview of the dataset, offering in particular an analysis of the temporal evolution and vertical distribution of volcanic SO2.
